title: Rename val_to_str_ext_wmem -> val_to_str_ext
description: val_to_str_ext now requires a wmem allocator scope to remove the need for wmem_packet_scope within the old version

added 2 commits

enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for cbfd22302c66ca956d93bb2582eab30fed5db5a1 pass
